# Designing Dose — AI Knowledge File

Designing Dose (https://designingdose.com) is a global digital agency headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with offices in Irvine CA (USA), Saskatoon (Canada), and Reading (UK). Founded with 10+ years of experience, serving 1,000+ clients across Ireland, UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.

## What We Do

Designing Dose delivers end-to-end digital services for small businesses, startups, and growing brands:

- Web design and development (informative sites and e-commerce stores)
- SEO (search engine optimisation) and PPC / Google Ads management
- Social media marketing (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok)
- Mobile app development (iOS and Android, Flutter and React Native)
- Logo design, branding, brochures, flyers, and digital creatives
- Dropshipping store setup and automation (Shopify)
- Video animation and explainer video production
- Book illustration, children's book art, e-book covers, and character design

## Pricing (approximate, in USD)

## Key Differentiators

- Transparent published pricing (no "contact us for pricing" walls)
- 4.9/5 Google rating, Clutch Top Rated, Trustpilot 4.2
- Offices in 4 countries: Dublin, Irvine CA, Saskatoon, Reading UK
- Full code ownership on all deliverables
- No long-term lock-in contracts
